## Problem

What workflow is difficult or unavailable today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-facing behavior and the smallest useful scope.

## Jenkins migration context

If this replaces or maps to Jenkins behavior, include a minimal example and
identify any semantic differences that must remain visible.

## Evidence and acceptance criteria

- [ ] The proposal identifies supported platforms and runtime assumptions.
- [ ] Secrets and private repository data are excluded from examples.
- [ ] The behavior can be validated with deterministic local checks.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches or workarounds did you consider?
